title: Temple of Seti I (Abydos)

buildingCutout.basis: The exact standing temple and south wing footprint supplies the replacement outline.

terrainReference.basis: Original open court grade north of the standing portico.

mapIdentity.provider: Named archaeological site and the mapped standing roof plan at Abydos.
mapIdentity.scope: The named Abydos archaeological perimeter and mapped standing L-shaped temple outline establish the plan and northeast orientation. Edward Bell’s historic published plan supplies the porch, interior column and chapel spacing.

note: The exact public-domain Qualla photograph records the surviving flat-roof portico and ruined court in 1990. ARCE and Bell document the twelve square piers, central main door, limestone walls and relative organization of both hypostyle halls.
